routeScope: Same-document actual #/play/nature/winter_lodge → #/play/nature/rural_summer_night → #/guide navigation in a fresh browser. This isolates shared player-host release; it is not the complete Nature-studio persistence sequence.
limits: No engine dispose method is instrumented; only owner data attributes and native context events are observed.
All-context loss and owner resource disposal are distinct contracts. Absent loss cannot identify a leaked resource.
No capture, GL fence, readback, rendering-quality change or user gesture is introduced. Browser closure is not an engine disposal pass.
